name: Shark Shaman
summary: Some druids emulate the deadly shark, a remorseless hunter that marine dwellers dread.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: A shark shaman who chooses an animal companion must select a shark. If choosing a domain, a shark shaman may choose the Animal, Death, War, or Water domain.

features.name: Wild Empathy (Ex)
features.summary: A shark shaman can use wild empathy with fish as a full-round action with a +4 bonus.

features.name: Totem Transformation (Su)
features.summary: At 2nd level, a shark shaman may adopt an aspect of the shark while retaining her normal form. This ability functions as the dragon shaman’s totem transformation ability, but the druid may select from the following bonuses: movement (can breathe water, swim speed 30 feet), senses (scent 30 feet, scent 90 feet in water), natural weapons (bite 1d6 for a Medium shaman), or shark skin (+2 natural armor, creatures grappling the shaman take 1 point of slashing damage per round of grapple). While using totem transformation, the shark shaman may speak normally and can cast speak with animals (fish only) at will.

resourceActions.label: Activate Totem Transformation

modes.label: Movement
modes.summary: Breathe water and gain a 30-foot swim speed.

activeEffects.label: Aquatic movement
activeEffects.description: Breathe water and gain a 30-foot swim speed.

modes.label: Senses
modes.summary: Gain scent 30 feet, increased to 90 feet in water.

activeEffects.label: Shark scent
activeEffects.description: Gain scent 30 feet, increased to 90 feet in water.

modes.label: Natural weapons
modes.summary: Gain a bite attack (1d6 for Medium).

activeEffects.label: Shark bite
activeEffects.description: Gain a bite attack (1d6 for Medium).

modes.label: Shark skin
modes.summary: +2 natural armor bonus to AC. Creatures grappling you take 1 slashing damage each round.

activeEffects.label: Rough skin
activeEffects.description: Creatures grappling you take 1 slashing damage each round.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 minute of Totem Transformation and apply the selected aspect for 10 rounds.

resourceActions.label: Speak with rays and sharks

confirmations.label: The target is one of the permitted rays and sharks

resourceActions.summary: At-will speak with animals, restricted to rays and sharks.

features.name: Totemic Summons (Su)
features.summary: At 5th level, a shark shaman may use summon nature’s ally I to summon a stingray and summon nature’s ally II to summon a manta ray. She may cast summon nature’s ally as a standard action when summoning rays and sharks, and summond rays and sharks gain a number of temporary hit points equal to her druid level. This ability otherwise functions as the dragon shaman’s totemic summons ability.

resourceActions.label: Resolve Totemic Summons

confirmations.label: The summon creates rays and sharks

modes.label: Young (spell level -1)
modes.summary: Apply the young template and reduce the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Normal
modes.summary: Use the normal summon spell level.

modes.label: Advanced (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the advanced template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Giant (spell level +1)
modes.summary: Apply the giant template and increase the required summon spell level by 1.

modes.label: Advanced + giant (spell level +2)
modes.summary: Apply both templates and increase the required summon spell level by 2.

activeEffect.name: Shark Shaman Totemic Summons
activeEffect.description: Summoned rays and sharks gain temporary hit points equal to your druid level; track their summon duration separately.

resourceActions.summary: Cast summon nature's ally as a standard action for rays and sharks; summoned creatures gain temporary hit points equal to druid level.

features.name: Wild Shape (Su)
features.summary: At 6th level, a shark shaman’s wild shape ability functions at her druid level –2. If she takes on the form of a shark, she instead uses her druid level +2. This ability replaces wild shape.

resourceActions.label: Assume Shaman Wild Shape

activeEffects.label: Favored wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level +2.

activeEffects.label: Adjusted wild shape
activeEffects.description: Resolve wild shape at druid level -2.

resourceActions.summary: Spend 1 wild shape use and track the correct effective druid level for the selected form.

progressionProfiles.label: Wild Shape Effective Level
progressionProfiles.summary: Effective druid levels used by normal and totem-favored wild shape forms.

features.name: Bonus Feat
features.summary: At 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter, a shark shaman gains one of the following bonus feats: Bleeding Critical, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Self-Sufficient, or Skill Focus (Swim). She must meet prerequisites for these bonus feats. This ability replaces venom immunity.

mechanicalNotes: Nature Bond restrictions, Wild Empathy, daily transformation minutes, aspect modes, at-will animal speech, template-aware summons, effective wild-shape levels, and all bonus-feat slots are automated.
